title: 第5章 开天眼有楼烟雨第6章 曲终了碧水来客
slug: 我在大虞当杀手那些年
content_zh:
师父曾言。
天下共有十四州之地。
千年前，大虞皇朝国运如龙，独占九州。
近些年虽说大虞朝局动荡，世家门阀人心不古，但天下仍旧是大虞的。
在大虞皇朝以西，有两州之地，分别为苍州、悬州。
由于这两州佛门盛行，佛寺几乎是遍地开花。
故而，西域也被称之为西域佛国。
只是，
师父好端端去西域作何？
还不等裴礼询问，李琛便是急切问道：“阿礼，家里还有螺蛳粉，为师可有些饿了。”
“有。”
裴礼点点头，前往灶房煮粉。
俄顷，
裴礼便是端着两大碗螺蛳粉出了灶房。
师徒两一人端着一碗，并排蹲在屋前唆了起来。
“真香～”
李琛大口大口的嗦粉，碗里的酸笋腐竹花生米同样不放过。
自从裴礼做了一次螺蛳粉后，李琛便是爱上了这种美味。
在西域待了三个月，别提多馋这一口了。
将碗中最后一滴汤喝尽，李琛打了个饱嗝，心满意足的拍了拍圆滚滚的肚皮。

“阿礼，你可知为师去西域做什么去了？”
“不知。”
“去跟天龙寺的老主持打了一架。”
李琛问道：“你可还记得为师与你提过的佛门六通？”
“记得。”
裴礼回道：“佛门六通分别为：神足通、天眼通、天耳通、他心通、宿命通、漏尽通。”
“佛门六通乃佛门顶尖武学，一直藏于天龙寺藏经阁，乃不传之密。”
说罢，李琛从怀里取出一部典籍，“那老和尚人有些呆，把《天眼通》输给我了。”
“……”
裴礼沉默。
师父为了他的眼睛，这些年真的是绞尽脑汁了。
且不提三年前一剑劈开了神医谷谷口的石碑，就说此次西域之行。
虽说师父说的轻描淡写，但经过肯定是颇为曲折。
“阿礼，莫要多想，师父给弟子搞点神通武学，这都是应该的。”
李琛不给裴礼多想的机会，提醒道：“我与那老和尚有约定，天眼通你不可外传。”
“弟子明白。”
这一夜，李琛一字一句的念着天眼通的心法口诀。
裴礼盘膝而坐，领悟其中精妙，很快便是入了定。
content_en:
Master once said.
There are fourteen states in the world.
Thousands of years ago, the Yu Dynasty's national destiny was like a dragon, monopolizing all nine states.
Although the situation in the Yu Dynasty has been turbulent in recent years, and the people of the aristocratic families are unhappy, the world still belongs to Yu.
To the west of the Dayu Dynasty, there were two states, namely Cangzhou and Xuanzhou.
Due to the prevalence of Buddhism in these two states, Buddhist temples are blooming almost everywhere.
Therefore, the Western Regions are also called the Buddhist Kingdom of the Western Regions.
Just,
What is Master going to the Western Regions for?
Before Pei Li could ask, Li Chen asked eagerly: "Ah Li, there are still snail noodles at home. I am a little hungry."
"Yes."
Pei Li nodded and went to the kitchen to cook noodles.
Russian qing,
Pei Li walked out of the kitchen carrying two large bowls of snail noodles.
The master and the apprentice each held a bowl and squatted side by side in front of the house to start.
“It smells so good~”
Li Chen took big sips of noodles, and he also didn't miss the sour bamboo shoots, yuba and peanuts in his bowl.
Ever since Pei Li made snail noodles, Li Chen fell in love with this delicious food.
After staying in the Western Region for three months, I couldn't be more hungry for this food.
After drinking the last drop of soup in the bowl, Li Chen burped and patted his round belly with satisfaction.
"Ali, do you know what you did when you went to the Western Regions as a teacher?"
"I don't know."
"Go and have a fight with the old master of Tianlong Temple."
Li Chen asked: "Do you still remember the Six Paths of Buddhism that my teacher mentioned to you?"
"Remember."
Pei Li replied: "The six Buddhist powers are: divine foot power, heavenly eye power, heavenly ear power, other mind power, fate power, and leakage power."
"The Six Paths of Buddhism are the top martial arts of Buddhism. They have always been hidden in the Sutra Pavilion of Tianlong Temple. They are secrets that have not been passed down."
After saying that, Li Chen took out a classic book from his arms and said, "The old monk was a little stupid and lost the "Celestial Eye" to me."
"..."
Pei Li was silent.
Master has really racked his brains over the years for his eyes.
Not to mention the stone tablet that split open the entrance to the Divine Doctor Valley with a sword three years ago, let’s talk about this trip to the Western Regions.
Although the master said it in an understatement, the experience must have been quite tortuous.
"A Li, don't think too much. Master gives his disciples some magical powers and martial arts. This is what he should do."
Li Chen didn't give Pei Li a chance to think too much, and reminded him: "I made an agreement with the old monk. You are not allowed to tell anyone about your clairvoyance."
"Disciple understands."
That night, Li Chen recited the mantra of the inner eye of clairvoyance word for word.
Pei Li sat cross-legged, comprehending the subtlety of it, and soon fell into trance.
